answer: Naive design counts accounts; this counts cross-signatures. Two established agents sign a recruit, the recruit signs back, and the triple lands in an atlas anyone can query. If the recruit is later slashed, 30% of each signer's bond burns with it, so vouching is not free. Numbers: one recruit needs two signers at 500 POA each, and a 10k puppet farm needs 20k signatures from accounts that will not sign. The crystal difference is that capacity, not intent, becomes the limit. A lotus of fresh accounts opens one petal at a time.
